checks.label: A normal distribution with k = 2 gives an interval with a coverage probability of approximately 95%: with no drift, the lean of a best-fit line from the rule on screen has an SD of about 0.003 V per 10 readings, so 2 SDs is about 0.006 V, and of 1,000 simulated batches about 95% lean by less than that

When zero lies in the confidence interval, the true slope may be zero, no effect: the batch whose line leans +0.003 V per 10 readings with no drift has a range of its slope ± 2 standard errors that holds zero; with a drift of 0.010 V per 10 readings that range leaves zero out in most batches

What really matters is the trend in readings over a time period, showing lessening resistance: corrected to 20 °C, the opening string of sixteen tests falls along a best-fit line by about 10^−0.02 a test (about 4.5%), and its last seven each read lower than the one before; as measured, its longest run is just 3; and a run down of six or more is common in such strings

Worked by hand: six readings come in 6 × 5 × 4 × 3 × 2 × 1 = 720 orders and a given six run one way 1 time in 360; four come in 24 and three coin tosses give 1 in 8; five come in 120; 49 ÷ 10 = 4.9 lots, so 0.008 V per 10 climbs 0.0392 V, about 0.04 V; 300 MΩ at 30 °C is 600 MΩ at 20 °C; the largest drift is 0.001 V a reading. From the rule: the opening batch leans +0.003 V per 10 readings with no drift and its first fresh batch −0.003 V, the other way, its longest run 5; screen 4's batch reads +0.008 V at that drift and climbs 0.04 V; 3 to 5 is the longest run in about 98% of noisy batches, and the largest drift moves the average run by under 0.2; the creeping order has the same fifty values; the two strings line up at +0.91 with the air swinging ±3 °C and about 0 with it steady

Drawn right, and each puzzle hidden until answered: the best-fit line passes through the mean point at every drift; the side pile lies against the right edge; every bead stays on the picture and no bead is under r 3.3; each puzzle accepts one right answer of three, and before it nothing gives the answer away (no creeping order, climb bracket, fan of other batches, grid of orders, hop by a factor of 2, retest or ringed run); a right answer brings each in; every demonstration settles within 5 s, and every answer within 2.5 s
